scientific_integrity: The exact algebraic result is supported by a self-contained analytical proof and reproducible finite checks; the latter do not constitute an independent proof or independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Strictly positive within-group and cross-group correlations; both community sizes at least two; symmetric positive diagonal congruence only.
No extension to indefinite matrices, singular boundary matrices, negative correlations, or arbitrary full-block preconditioners.
Published overlap has not been exhaustively excluded; complete text of Shapiro (1985) was inaccessible.
title: Exact diagonal condition-number scaling for two-community equicorrelation matrices
